legendTitle: The same seven objects, now for image rows
provenance: The main numerical story is computed in the page by one hand-named attention layer: an 8×8 scene, sixteen 2×2 patches and a CLS row, with d<sub>model</sub> = {{d_model}}{{axes}}. The patch projection, the position rows and the CLS start are fixed so that the names stay true; W<sub>Q</sub>, W<sub>K</sub>, W<sub>V</sub>, W<sub>O</sub> and the class head were trained on scenes A and B for 1,500 Adam steps, and scene C is a probe the model never saw. The fitted toy omits LayerNorm and the feed-forward sublayer. Section 10 separately replays the same 17 rows with a hand-chosen second head, then identifies the pieces of a full ViT; its two-head numbers are not trained. The photograph in section 2 is an illustration, and the model never sees it.
